simplesect.para: XST_FAILURE if interrupt setup fails. After setup, the function runs the self-test, prints the result, and loops to service IPIs. That loop does not return.

briefdescription.para: Demonstrates the XIpiPsu driver by sending an IPI to self.

detaileddescription.para: The example sends an Inter-Processor Interrupt (IPI) message to self and gets a response. Each IPI channel can trigger an interrupt to itself and can exchange messages through the message buffer. The example uses this feature to exercise the driver APIs.

Example control flow:
Initializes the IPI and Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) drivers.
Sets up the interrupt system with an IPI handler that inverts the received message and sends it back as the response.
Writes a message and triggers an IPI to self.
Polls for the response until the timeout expires.
The interrupt handler receives the IPI and sends back the response.
Reads the received response and verifies it.
Prints a success or failure message based on the response check.
